dk_first_steps.accept_text: North-west, at the treeline by the old goldmine claim - past the last of the graves. Find out what the body still does.

dk_scavenger_scraps.accept_text: South-east, at the burned farmstead past the fence - that's where the scavengers den. Every piece. I'll know what's missing.

dk_stray_cull.accept_text: South of here, round the graves and the gate. Mind the newly risen - they can't defend themselves.

dk_neshka.accept_text: Night Web's Hollow again - the cave beside the claim, north-west - and this time to its centre. The brood comes first. They always do.
